svg.aria-label: What the AI does versus what the operator does inside a deployment
svg.text: FIGURE 14.1 — THE DIVISION OF LABOUR
One column compresses. The other never has.
THE MACHINE
minutes to hours
THE OPERATOR
days to weeks — does not compress
First-draft matching / reconciliation logic
The domain fact that makes the draft correct
Cleaning and structuring messy data
Learning why the mess exists in the first place
Testing against historical records
Judging whether the mismatch count is real
Drafting the security posture documentation
Earning the CISO's trust in the room
Flagging anomalies in the data
Deciding which anomaly is worth acting on
Iterating a fix in minutes, on request
Deciding when the correction cycle is done
Producing a technically complete system
Getting the team to actually trust and use it
The unit did not get replaced. It got smaller — because the part that was pure engineering labour compressed, and the part that was trust did not.
